instruction: The first phone's Simple Gallery Pro has a `Receipts` album with three receipt images. On the second phone, create one incomplete review task per image, using the exact image filename as the task title.
surfaces: android_0 Simple Gallery Pro -> android_1 Tasks app
fixture_notes: Only Simple Gallery Pro is required on the source phone and only Tasks is required on the target phone.
Scoring requires exactly the three visible filenames as distinct incomplete task titles.
